text:
Sophie: Quick sync — OrbitCloud marketplace listing needs localized CTAs and updated logo lockups for JP/KR. Partner wants one solution brief and three marketplace tiles. Can design + legal review this week?
Tom: I can handle lockup spacing. Need partner SVGs in RGB, 1x and 2x. Any brand exceptions? :thinking:
Maria: Partner legal said they only allow approved logo files — ask them to send the 'OrbitCloud_approved.zip'. I'll ping them now.
Kevin: Heads-up: trademark line must be included under logo for JP market per their guidelines. Also need a signed logo use form before publish.
Sophie: Uploaded copy variations here: https://figma.com/file/xyz123/oc-marketplace-localization — feel free to comment inline.
Sophie: CTA options (short): `Try OrbitCloud` | `Start free trial` | `Explore integrations` — want tone to be slightly more formal in JP, friendlier in KR.
Tom: For accessibility: provide alt text for each hero image. Example alt: `OrbitCloud integrations dashboard — latency savings overview`.
brand-bot: Quick checklist: [ ] SVGs received, [ ] Logo release signed, [ ] Localized copy QA, [ ] Alt text added, [ ] Legal signoff.
Maria: @Sophie @Kevin I'm asking partner for logo zip + legal contact. ETA 48h.
Kevin: If partner legal delays, we can publish with a neutral lockup (no partner tagline) and hold the localized CTAs until approval. Not ideal but safe.
Sophie: Updated filenames in Figma to follow naming convention: `orbitcloud_BR_JP_hero.svg`, `orbitcloud_BR_KR_hero.svg`, `orbitcloud_solution_brief_v1.pdf` — Tom please export and drop into shared drive `/partners/orbitcloud/`.
Tom: On it. Will export 1x/2x, optimize PNGs, and check color profiles. ETA 24h. :thumbsup:
Maria: Also requested partner-provided translation glossary (brand terms to keep in English) — they said they'll send by EOD tomorrow.
Sophie: If we get glossary, PM will do a quick review and then send to vendor for proofreading.
Kevin: Keep the partner legal thread CC'd in the doc. We need a signed asset release before publishing any co-branded case studies.
Tom: Minor design ask: partner prefers a white-on-transparent lockup on dark hero only. I'll create both light/dark variants.
Maria: Noted. Will confirm dark-hero permission with partner.
Sophie: Thanks all — I'll update this thread after partner responds. If we hit no blockers by Fri EOD, I'll schedule the marketplace push for next Mon morning.
